sc_cat_item.description:
Requesting "Break Glass" access in Production is a restricted item, and should only be requested in circumstances where the approved mechanism for gaining privileged access (ie using SSO/CyberArk) has been compromised and there is an emergency need to gain Read/Write access to the instance from your normal local Read-Only Administrator account.

This request submission requires approval from an SRE/Releaser colleague, and Read/Write access will only be granted for a limited period of time - after which it will be automatically reverted.
